story:
Quality Roofing Express is an independent, family owned business that came out of a small local town in northeastern Pennsylvania. We connect with our community and the surrounding areas to provide quality work, and we take pride in treating each home as if it were our own. As homeowners ourselves, we know what it is to worry about weather damage — and we know that the memories made in a home are a treasure worth protecting.

The company is owner-run. Osman is on the job, not just on the paperwork, and customers name him personally in their reviews. One homeowner has now had us out for a third and fourth roof across five years — his own house, then his son's. In Pennsylvania, where the state issues no roofing license and registration only confirms that a contractor carries insurance, that kind of repeat business is the only credential that means anything. We would rather be judged on it than on a badge.

We work on everything a Scranton house wears. Asphalt shingles from three-tab through architectural and slate-look, natural slate, standing metal, and every common flat-roof membrane — EPDM rubber, TPO, torch-down modified bitumen and peel-and-stick — residential and commercial alike. Most residential roofs go on in a day. And when the truck pulls out, the debris is in the dumpster, the magnet has been over the lawn and the driveway, and somebody has walked the property. Three separate Google reviewers brought up our cleanup without being asked. That is the part of this job we are proudest of.
